smells.finding: reopen_total()'s body is 8 lines with one loop and one guard; mechanical_fields() lost a parameter and a branch in this diff rather than gaining any. Nothing lengthened.

EscalatedReopenIsNotAReopenTests carries seven fixture helpers (build/verb/say/complete/rework/escalate/snapshot/journal_reopen_lines/rework_total) for two test methods. Observation, not a blocker: every helper is used by both tests and the escalation scenario genuinely cannot be reached with fewer steps, but the class is at the size where a shared spine fixture would start paying.

The new class re-implements build/verb/complete, which the file's existing LiveSpine helper already provides. The divergences are real (a config.rework_cap of 1, a three-item spine, and `say` asserting the engine's own message on every verb), so this is an observation rather than a defect - but the two fixtures are now one refactor apart and the next escalation test will make it three.

The test reconstructs the journal and mechanical-snapshot paths itself (self.dir / 'spine.json.journal', self.dir / 'mechanical' / step.json) instead of calling engine.journal_path()/ec.snapshot_path(). That is an independent restatement of the path contract, which is what a test should do - asserting a convention with the helper that implements it would let a helper bug hide.
No repeated argument group appears or is introduced; the diff removes one (checklist + base_dir + spine_path collapses to checklist + base_dir).
reopens stays an int-or-None, which is the field's contract in docs/EPISODE_STORE.md's mechanical bin; no primitive is standing in for a missing type.
The diff shortens two signatures rather than lengthening any: reopen_total(checklist, spine_path) -> reopen_total(checklist), and mechanical_fields loses spine_path.

Verified by sweep, not assumed: journal_reopens, find_spine_path and _rework_total have zero references anywhere in the repo, and no caller passes spine_path= to mechanical_fields. Deleting ~84 lines required edits in exactly one production file.
episode_capture.py continues to change for one reason - what the mechanical field group reports. This edit is squarely that reason.
The deepest reach in the new code is checklist.get('tasks').values(); the deleted find_spine_path was the longest chain in the module and is gone.

The diff is a net REMOVAL of speculative generality: find_spine_path's multi-checklist disambiguation and the two-witness reconciliation both existed for cases the measurement showed were either unreachable or actively wrong.

reopen_total() now carries a 38-line docstring over an 8-line body, and mechanical_fields gained a 10-line comment over a 3-line guard. On Fowler's baseline reading that ratio is prima facie deodorant.

override.repo_standard: docs/EPISODE_STORE.md - the mechanical bin's rule that a plausible wrong number is worse than an absent one, restated as the g2 obligation, together with the in-code decision:refuse-never-fabricate this composer is written against.
override.reason: The prose is not covering for unclear code - the eight lines are self-evident. It records the MEASUREMENT that falsified the previous sourcing (an escalated reopen journals a line without incrementing rework_count) and the cost that was accepted in exchange. This entire rework exists because the earlier docstring asserted an invariant nobody had measured; deleting the measured rationale to satisfy a length heuristic would recreate exactly that failure. The standard subordinates the smell.
